text:
akshay: Heads-up — planning to run the infra apply for release v1.12.3 in the 21:00 UTC change window. Main risky bits: cross-account IAM trust for replication, a small route deletion in edge (us-west-2), and a provider bump. Need eyeballs + rollback plan.

maya: quick Q — did you pin the provider and record lockfile? last time a provider drift caused plan diffs.

akshay: yes pinned in versions.tf and committed terraform.lock.hcl. Deploybot still picks up shared runner image so I’ll pin the release branch on the CI job before apply.

jon: we should two-stage the apply: iam-only first (ensure trust created), then full apply. If anything looks off, we can abort before route deletion.

lina: agree with jon. also ensure dynamodb state lock TTL is long enough for the two-stage run.

akshay: plan output (trimmed):
```
  # aws_iam_role.replication will be created
  + resource "aws_iam_role" "replication" {
      + name = "replication-role-v1-12-3"
    }

  # aws_route.edge_route (us-west-2) will be destroyed
  - resource "aws_route" "edge_route" {
      - destination_cidr_block = "10.2.0.0/16" -> null
    }
```

maya: that route deletion worries me — can you confirm no active sessions hit that prefix?

akshay: checked session logs last 24h, traffic is only to the canary subnet (we keep a shadow route). will not delete edge_route until canary healthy. plan shows destroy because we have a cleaned-up config; I'm preparing a manual gate.

infra-bot: state lock acquired: dynamo://infra-state-lock (owner akshay) at 1748799940.

deploybot: release-hook: v1.12.3 is blocked pending infra-apply-completion. CI will wait up to 2 hours.

jon: rollback playbook (short):
- if IAM trust break -> revert to previous commit: git revert <commit-hash-iam-change> and run terraform apply for iam only.
- if route removal causes failure -> re-create route with: terraform apply -target=aws_route.edge_route (or apply previous state via `terraform state rm`/import).
- if provider regression observed -> pin provider in runner and redeploy previous TF binary image.

akshay: exact commands I'll run:
```bash
# iam-only stage
terraform plan -target=aws_iam_role.replication -out=iam-plan && terraform apply "iam-plan"
# after 10m health check
terraform plan -out=full-plan && terraform apply "full-plan"
```

maya: approve for 21:00 window assuming
- iam-only at 21:05
- 10m observation
- full apply after canary ok

lina: please tag the run in the release notes and include the plan snippet + rollback steps.

sre-oncall: I'll be oncall for the window and will watch canary latency/5xxs. Pager threshold: 200ms p50 or any 5xx spike. I have the runbook open.

akshay: publishing release notes now (will add the IAM snippet and partner notification). Starting staging preflight plan in 15m. tagging the CI job to use branch pin `release/v1.12.3-pin`.

maya: :thumbsup: ping here when iam-only apply finishes.

akshay: will do. thanks everyone.

deploybot: note: if apply takes >30m, deploybot will post a warning and pause the pipeline automatically.

akshay: acknowledged. if anything unexpected appears I'll abort and revert the PR with the previous TF state.

jon: small nit — include KMS key alias in release notes; partner scripts need to reference the alias instead of raw ARN after trust change.

akshay: added KMS alias note. starting preflight now.

maya: thanks — standing by for results.
